# Support

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/alirezaopmc/dorost/issues) for usage questions, reproducible bugs, and feature requests. Check the README and examples first, and keep proposals independent of a particular institution or document type.

For a bug report, include the Dorost version, Typst compiler version, operating system, compile target, the smallest source that reproduces the issue, and whether the named fonts are installed or supplied with `--font-path`. For Persian rendering problems, say whether the issue appears in the rendered page or only in extracted PDF text.

This project is maintained in spare time and has no response-time guarantee.
